summary: Describes the initial login screen, which serves as a dashboard, and how to access specific modules like the Student module (also referred to as SAS module) from the left-hand navigation panel.
steps: Log in to the ERP system.
The first screen displayed after login is the dashboard.
Locate the 'Student' (SAS) module on the left navigation panel.
Click on 'Student' to view reports and information related to students.
important_notes: The first screen after login is always a dashboard.
The 'Student' module is also known as the 'SAS module'.
Clicking 'Student' in the left navigation displays all student-related reports and information.
questions: How do I access the Student module after logging in?
What is the initial screen displayed upon logging into the ERP system?
Where can I find student-related reports and information?
